title: Final Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the relation |psi(0)|^2 = (m/2π) <dV(r)/dr> - (1/2π) <L^2/r^3>.

title: Second Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the relation <dV(r)/dr> = (1/m) <L^2/r^3>.

title: Classical Interpretation
description: Important Criteria: The student should provide a correct classical interpretation of the derived equations for l ≠ 0.

title: Integration Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct integration steps leading to the final equations.

title: Boundary Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention the appropriate boundary conditions used in the derivation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for unit consistency in the final equations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the equations.

title: Physical Meaning
description: Optional Criteria: The student should discuss the physical meaning of the terms in the equations.
